name: Ottawa

neighborhoods.name: Centretown
neighborhoods.homes: older apartment buildings and houses split into units

housing: Ottawa renters live in low-rise and high-rise apartment buildings, houses split into units, and suburban townhouses.

localRules.text: Most residential tenancies in Ontario signed on or after April 30, 2018 must use the province's standard lease; a landlord may take a rent deposit but not a damage deposit.

tenantHelp.name: Advocacy Centre for Tenants Ontario (ACTO)
tenantHelp.what: free duty counsel for low-income tenants at the Landlord and Tenant Board

climate: Test the heating and check windows for drafts; Ottawa winters are very cold and snowy.
fact: Sandy Hill near the University of Ottawa has many student rentals in older houses.
